answer:
Created [src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g3_checkout_request/okf/codex/1/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — a no-import ES module exporting `buildCheckoutRequest`, returning `{method: "POST", path: "cart/<cartCode>/checkout", body}` with the backend's field names: `quoteId` (chosen shipping option), `currency`, `termsAccepted`, `orderNote`, and `payment` as `{paymentType: "CREDITCARD", transactionType: "CAPTURE", processor, cardToken, amount}`. Verified by running the module, and it's the only new/changed file in `src/`.

Files used: `src/pages/other/Checkout.js` (how the request is built), `src/util/constant.js` (the `checkout` action), and the OKF backend guide — `okf/references/backend/routes.md` (route signature), `modules/com.salesmanager.shop.model.order.v1.md` (`quoteId`, `termsAccepted`, `orderNote`, `currency`), and `modules/com.salesmanager.shop.model.order.transaction.md` (`PersistablePayment`: `cardToken`, `processor`, `amount`).
